release.content: pubdoc 0.4.0 was released on 2026-11-19 from commit e484043ad0fa9f2accf910676541a5a9a32a7735 with these changes.

rows: pubdoc corpus init [PROJECT] [--bitwarden-project ID] [--backup-name NAME] [--no-backup]: makes the corpus versions are signed in and its key with pub, names the key as corpus.key, declares it in pubrules.json's signing_keys, keeps the store out of git and backs the key up with pubsec's pinned wheel; idempotent; where the config trusts a key this machine lacks it points to pubsec signing-key restore, and around a key restored that way it rebuilds the store with pub sign --restore-key and checks it is the trusted key

pubdoc build --date YYYY-MM-DD, which approve now passes too: the doc's date, which templates print, unless a part sets its own, and the PDFs' creation time; with it and the pinned fonts, the PDFs approved before versions existed rebuild identically

pubdoc renders with the fonts it carries alone (typst --ignore-system-fonts and pubdoc's fonts/: DejaVu Sans, Ubuntu Regular and Liberation Sans, beside typst's own), so a render no longer changes with the fonts a machine has installed
